name: Kent P Dauten
current_role: Chairman and co-founder, Keystone Capital (Chicago); independent director, Iron Mountain (since 1997)
profile: Chicago private equity investor who began at First Chicago Venture Capital in 1979 and co-founded Madison Dearborn Partners. In 1994 he co-founded Keystone Capital; its first company, a medical records business he ran, was built via ~a dozen acquisitions and merged into Iron Mountain, where he has been a director since.
interesting_fact: He personally ran Keystone's first portfolio company, a healthcare records management firm (Record Masters), rolling up about a dozen acquisitions before merging it into Iron Mountain and briefly running its Health Care Division.
deep_cut_fact: Beyond finance he chaired the board of Chicago's Museum of Science and Industry, chaired Lutheran Social Services of Illinois, and served as an elected member and president of his local school district board.
notes: kdauten@ address was listed as media/contact in Keystone's own 2021 Fund II press release (Business Wire); could not re-fetch page (403) to reconfirm. Active Milken Institute participant (brain health).
